data.body: Addressed plan-review BLOCK (single-turn verifier can't do a real present-state check): the on-target veto is now COHORT-RESTRICTED to CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6), mirroring asserted_capability_confirmed — enforced deterministically in orchestrator.pass3_over_findings (_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded forces the answer to na for non-grounded findings) AND documented in both verifier prompts. Added test_pass3_on_target_veto_restricted_to_grounded_cohort proving a tool-less non-grounded yes does NOT fire the veto while a grounded yes does.
